MFT 快速扫描几秒内完成，无需暂停: MFT quick scans finish in seconds; no need to pause
MFT 快速扫描时把附加在文件上的隐藏数据流计入大小（硬扫描不读取数据流）: Counts the hidden data streams attached to files in their size during an MFT quick scan (a full scan doesn't read streams).
SpaceSniffer 的配色（磁盘 / 文件夹 / 文件 / 可用 / 未知: SpaceSniffer's colors (disk / folder / file / free / unknown space): SpaceKnife's treemap colors are fixed, not imported.
SpaceSniffer 配置不是有效的 XML：{reason}: The SpaceSniffer configuration isn't valid XML: {reason}
Windows 任务栏闪烁、macOS 程序坞图标弹跳、Linux 窗口紧急提示: Flashes the taskbar on Windows, bounces the Dock icon on macOS, sets the urgent hint on Linux.
i18n 的语言代码 {value!r} 无效（例：en、zh-tw）: Invalid i18n language code {value!r} (e.g. en, zh-tw)
i18n.{lang} 只能包含 title、reason、note、app: i18n.{lang} can only contain title, reason, note, app
id {value!r} 无效：只能用字母、数字和 . _ -，并以字母或数字开: Invalid id {value!r}: use only letters, digits and . _ -, starting with a letter or a digit
类别最多 {n} 个: There can be at most {n} classes.
「其他」类别不能填扩展名：它收纳所有未归类的扩展名: The "Other" class can't have extensions: it holds every unclassified extension.
不支持 ~，请改用相对模式（如 .cache/pip，可匹配任意层级）: ~ isn't supported. Use a relative pattern instead (like .cache/pip, which matches at any depth)
不认识这个文件：既不是 SpaceKnife 导出的设置，也不是 SpaceSn: Unknown file: neither settings exported by SpaceKnife nor SpaceSniffer's SpaceSnifferConfig.xml.
与工具栏的「树图｜火焰图｜火焰-极坐标图」对应: The same choice as the visualization buttons on the toolbar.
与工具栏的「类别｜扁平｜时间｜分支」对应: The same choice as the coloring buttons on the toolbar.
主要按钮、当前导航项、开关、滑块和焦点环: Used by primary buttons, the current navigation item, switches, sliders and focus rings.
仅启动只读扫描助手，主程序不提权；关闭后没有管理员权限时直接改用硬扫描: Only the read-only scan helper is elevated, never the app itself. When off, a full scan is used without administrator rights.
从启动页开始的扫描与重新扫描: Scans started from the start page, and rescans.
使用 USN 日志 + ReadDirectoryChangesEx，变化的文件: Uses the USN journal and ReadDirectoryChangesEx. Changed files flash.
供启动页的最近记录和快照对比使用: Used by the recent scans on the start page and by snapshot comparison.
保留 SpaceKnife 的「{name}」类别（SpaceSniffer 没: Kept SpaceKnife's "{name}" class (SpaceSniffer has no such class).
元素比例 proportions：两边的刻度不同，不导入（可在「树图 › 元素比: Block proportions (proportions): the scales differ, not imported (set it in "Treemap › Block proportions").
其他程序让整块磁盘超过上限时，扫描降到最低进度: When other programs push the whole disk past the limit, the scan slows down to a minimum.
写入日志文件的最低级别: The lowest level written to the log file.
切换元素时保持打开: Keep open when moving between blocks
切换后全部文字、日期与数字格式立即更换: All text, dates and number formats change at once.
刷新间隔 refreshDelayMs：SpaceKnife 自动调节刷新，不需: Refresh interval (refreshDelayMs): SpaceKnife adjusts refreshing by itself, not needed.
双击放大或返回时的过渡时长；0 表示无动画: How long the transition takes when you double-click to zoom in or go back. 0 turns it off.
只在 Windows 的 NTFS 卷上可用: Only available on NTFS volumes on Windows.
只在操作时使用高帧率，更省电: Uses a high frame rate only while you interact, which saves power.
只影响树图：偏高 ↔ 偏宽；0 表示尽量接近正方形: Treemap only. Taller ↔ wider. 0 keeps blocks as square as possible.
只计一次时，合计与磁盘实际占用一致: Counted once, the totals match the real size on disk.
同一文件夹内大块排在左上: Larger blocks go to the top left within a folder.
名称 {value!r} 不能为空或包含路径分隔符（多层路径请写进 paths）: The name {value!r} can't be empty or contain a path separator (put paths of several levels in paths)
「空闲」档位使用系统低 I/O 优先级，不与前台程序抢磁盘: The "Idle" level uses the low I/O priority and leaves the disk to the apps you are using.
块边框的强弱（柔和 ↔ 锐利）: How strong block borders are (soft ↔ sharp).
字段 {key} 不能为空列表: Field {key} can't be an empty list
字段 {key} 的值 {value!r} 无效，可选 {choices}: Invalid value {value!r} for field {key}, choose from {choices}
字符串或字符串列表: a string or a list of strings
对比时不可用，先退出对比: Not available in a comparison. Leave the comparison first.
实时监控发现变化后的定点重扫: Targeted rescans after live monitoring sees a change.
还没有接入：实时监控的定点重扫不按这一档限速: Not wired up yet: live monitoring's targeted rescans don't use this level.
实时缩放 useRealZoom（DynaZoom）：还没有实现: Live zoom (useRealZoom, DynaZoom): not implemented yet.
小于这个尺寸的元素并入「N 个小项」聚合块: Blocks smaller than this are merged into an "N small items" block.
已加载 {count} 条洞察规则（来自 {files} 个文件，跳过 {ski: Loaded {count} insight rules from {files} files ({skipped} problems skipped)
开启后缩放改为瞬时切换，扫描中的条纹不滚动: When on, zooming switches at once and the stripes stand still while scanning.
当前版本不可修改，已跳过：{name}: Skipped, can't be changed in this version: {name}
悬停或选中时点亮几层祖先标题栏（克制 ↔ 绚烂）: How many ancestor title bars light up on hover or selection (subtle ↔ vivid).
手动时同时扫描的工作进程数: How many worker processes scan at the same time in manual mode.
扫描中或文件变化时元素闪烁提示: Blocks flash while scanning or when their files change.
扫描后自动保存快照: Save a snapshot after each scan
大扫描存进映射文件: Keep large scans in mapped files
开启后，节点表超过 256 MB（约 200 万项）的扫描存进磁盘映射文件，不占: When on, scans whose node table passes 256 MB (about two million items) go to memory-mapped files on disk and take no private memory; after the scan this writes about 200 bytes per item to disk once.
扫描数据超过物理内存的这个比例后，新的节点表存进磁盘映射文件：不占私有提交，常用: Once scan data passes this share of physical memory, new node tables go to memory-mapped files on disk: they take no private commit, and the system keeps the parts in use in memory.
扫描结束时若窗口在后台则闪烁提醒: Flash the window when a scan finishes in the background
按交互调节帧率（DynaSmooth）: Adapt the frame rate to interaction (DynaSmooth)
按扫描根路径保存标签，重新扫描或打开快照后恢复: Tags are saved per scan root and come back after a rescan or when a snapshot is opened.
提示卡显示创建、修改、访问时间: The hover card shows the created, modified and accessed times.
收到警告或错误时自动展开日志面板；与日志面板里的开关是同一个设置: Opens the log panel on a warning or an error. The same setting as the switch in the log panel.
改了任意一个键后显示为「自定义」: Shows as "Custom" once any key is changed.
改键还没有实现（见 TODO）；下表列出当前键位: Changing keys isn't implemented yet (see TODO). The table below lists the current keys.
整卷视图里显示可用空间块: Shows the free space block in whole-volume views.
整卷视图里显示未知空间块: Shows the unknown space block in whole-volume views.
整盘繁忙时让路: Give way when the disk is busy
文件太大，不像是设置文件: The file is too large to be a settings file.
新视图切到火焰图或火焰-极坐标图时使用: Used when a new view switches to the flame graph or the polar flame graph.
新视图显示可用空间: Show free space in new views
新视图显示未知空间: Show unknown space in new views
新视图的细节层级，与工具栏「层级」一致: The detail level new views start with, the same as the level control on the toolbar.
无法读取洞察规则文件 {source}：{error}: Can't read the insight rule file {source}: {error}
显示名出现在详情面板和悬停卡里；过滤语法仍写 :red: The display name appears in the details panel and the hover card. Filters still use :red.
更早的快照每周只保留一份: Of older snapshots, one per week is kept.
有新事件时自动打开日志面板: Open the log panel on new events
未知设置 {key}（来自其他版本），已跳过: Skipped the unknown setting {key} (from another version).
标题栏、条和环的高度以及标签显示阈值随字号等比缩放: Title bar, bar and ring heights and the size at which labels appear scale with the font size.
树图有焦点时可省略 Ctrl: Ctrl is optional when the treemap has focus
根所在的一侧: Which side the root bar is on.
此时间内的连续变化合并为一次刷新: Changes within this time are merged into one refresh.
没有「完全磁盘访问权限」时，macOS 会为桌面、文稿、下载、云盘、照片图库和其: Without Full Disk Access, macOS asks one by one before the Desktop, Documents, Downloads, cloud drives, the Photos library and other apps' data can be read.
洞察规则 {rule} 在 {source} 中出现多次，以最后一条为准: The insight rule {rule} appears more than once in {source}. The last one is used.
洞察规则文件 {source} 不是有效的 TOML：{error}: The insight rule file {source} isn't valid TOML: {error}
洞察规则文件 {source} 有未知的顶层字段 {keys}，已忽略: Ignored unknown top-level fields in the insight rule file {source}: {keys}
洞察规则文件 {source} 的 rule 应为表数组（[[rule]]）: In the insight rule file {source}, rule must be an array of tables ([[rule]]).
洞察规则文件 {source} 的格式版本 {version} 不受支持（支持: Skipped the insight rule file {source}: format version {version} isn't supported (supported: {supported}).
浅色主题待设计（W7 待定 20）: The light theme isn't designed yet (W7 open item 20).
深色为石墨色调，对比度较高: Dark is a graphite theme with strong contrast.
火焰图和火焰-极坐标图默认配色: Default coloring for flame graphs and polar flame graphs
用「2 个月前」这样的相对时间显示: Shown as a relative time, like "2 months ago".
用户规则 {rule}（{source}）覆盖了同名规则: The user rule {rule} ({source}) replaces the rule with the same id
直接按 1–4 打标签、按 0 清除: Press 1–4 to tag and 0 to clear.
相邻层级底色的差别（平 ↔ 深）: How much the shade differs between neighboring levels (flat ↔ deep).
空闲时使用系统低 I/O 优先级: Use low I/O priority when idle
类别名「{name}」重复了（与「{other}」冲突）: The class name "{name}" is taken (it clashes with "{other}").
类别名不能为空: The class name can't be empty.
类别表 {} 读不出来，改用内置类别：{}: Can't read the class table {}, using the built-in classes: {}
缩放时长 zoomTimeMs：单位与 SpaceKnife 不同，不导入（可在: Zoom time (zoomTimeMs): the unit differs from SpaceKnife's, not imported (set it in "Treemap › Zoom animation duration").
缩放过程中元素实时重新排列: Blocks are rearranged live while zooming.
自动与快速 MFT：整个 NTFS 卷用 MFT 快速扫描（需要时请求一次管理员: Auto and Quick MFT: a whole NTFS volume gets an MFT quick scan (asking once for administrator rights when needed, a full scan if refused), every other location a full scan.
自动：按处理器核数选择；手动：按下面的数值: Auto: chosen from the number of processor cores. Manual: the number below.
自定义导出模板「{name}」：SpaceKnife 还不能保存自定义模板: Custom export template "{name}": SpaceKnife can't save custom templates yet.
至少要有一条 paths 或 names: At least one of paths or names is needed
花括号展开后的模式超过 {limit} 个: Brace expansion gives more than {limit} patterns
规则应为表: A rule must be a table
设置已被其他窗口修改（版本 {version}）: The settings were changed in another window (version {version}).
设置文件不合法，继续使用上一次的有效设置：{reason}: The settings file is invalid, so the last valid settings stay in use: {reason}
设置文件不是有效的 JSON：{reason}: The settings file isn't valid JSON: {reason}
这些设置在当前版本不可修改：{names}: These settings can't be changed in this version: {names}
这份设置来自更新版本的 SpaceKnife（格式 {version}），无法导: These settings come from a newer SpaceKnife (format {version}) and can't be imported.
进入挂载在文件夹下的其他卷；关闭时只统计当前卷: Goes into other volumes mounted in folders. When off, only the current volume is counted.
选中元素带投影，更容易追踪: The selected block casts a shadow, so it is easier to follow.
选择「自定义」档位时使用: Used when the "Custom" level is chosen.
限制扫描造成的磁盘读取占用: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
需要时请求管理员权限: Ask for administrator rights when needed
鼠标下的元素加白色内描边: The block under the mouse gets a white inner outline.
鼠标从一个块移到另一个块时，提示卡直接换成新内容: When the mouse moves from one block to another, the hover card switches to the new content.
鼠标划过的元素渐隐: Blocks the mouse passes over fade out.
每天最多一次，只读取 GitHub 上本项目的发布列表，不发送任何使用数据；小版: At most once a day, it only reads this project's release list on GitHub and sends no usage data; small updates only show a badge at the top right
预览版是 GitHub 上标为预发布（Pre-release）的版本: Previews are the releases marked as pre-release on GitHub
发现新版本后在后台下载并校验；只有你在更新卡片里点了「无缝更新」或安装方式才会安: A new version is downloaded and checked in the background. It is installed only when you click Seamless update or the other way in the update card, never by itself.
回收站 / 废纸篓里的东西蒙上一层暗纹、围上虚线，回收站本身标出清空后能释放多少: What lies in the Recycle Bin / Trash is shaded and hatched inside a dashed outline, and the bin itself says how much emptying it frees. "Moving": the dashes march and a band of light sweeps across now and then (still with "Reduce motion")
新视图显示回收站: Show the Recycle Bin in new views
扫描里有回收站 / 废纸篓时显示它；关掉后回收站不占画面，其余的块放大填满: Draws the Recycle Bin / Trash when the scan holds one. Off: the bin takes no room and the other blocks grow to fill the view
这次扫描里没有回收站: This scan has no Recycle Bin
文件夹归类 {path} 读不出来，已忽略：{error}: Could not read the folder classes in {path}, ignored: {error}
文件夹归类的格式不对，已忽略: The folder classes are not in the expected format, ignored
没有 id 为「{cid}」的类别: There is no class with the id "{cid}"
